jobs.title: Project Manager, Global Program Management - Production Solutions
jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

The Business Operations & Planning (BOP) organization is a core component of the Studio that fuels content production success through elevated operations, connected planning, and globally-scaled production solutions. Within BOP, the Global Production Solutions (GPS) team partners with regional production organizations and cross-functional teams, including Product & Technology, Data Science, and Legal, to develop and deploy technology solutions to our global slate of productions. Project managers in GPS orchestrate prioritized efforts and lead change management, connecting and accelerating solutions at scale while fostering collaboration across teams globally.

We are looking for an execution and results-oriented, highly effective Project Manager to support the development and global deployment of Netflix's media production technology, including a connected suite of cloud-based tools and workflows built for live-action productions worldwide. This role will directly manage the planning and operationalization of new capabilities, partnering closely with global teams to bring new tools online responsibly and at scale.

Responsibilities
- Own the rollout for new media production capabilities, partnering with Product, Design, and Engineering from early exploration through pilot and full-scale deployment.

- Concurrently manage multiple early-stage, interdependent initiatives across the portfolio, applying sound prioritization judgment when competing for limited resources.

- Serve as the operational connective layer across a broad studio technology ecosystem, partnering with the Product & Technology teams that own shared systems to ensure new capabilities integrate cleanly.

- Design and execute change management and rollout plans across multiple international markets, tailoring messaging and pacing to local production workflows, cultural nuances, and talent-relations.

- Orchestrate work across cross-functional partners (e.g. Finance, Legal, Operations, Support/IT, Post Production), creating a collaborative environment that accelerates measurable outcomes.

- Communicate program status, progress, risk, and performance clearly to stakeholders and senior leadership, including synthesizing feedback and sentiment gathered across regions into clear strategic recommendations.

- Establish a reliable, visible cadence for portfolio reviews, prioritization, and decision-making, so that improvements are measurable and progress is transparent to partners and stakeholders.

Qualifications
- 5-7+ years of experience in project management. Background in management consulting (or similar fast-paced, high-performance role) and/or an MBA is a plus.

- Experience with techniques and tools that drive process efficiency and continuous improvement (for example, Six Sigma, Lean thinking, Scrum).

- Knowledge and experience with the content creation process strongly preferred (for example, on-set production, post-production, and VFX workflows).

- Knowledge of product development practices preferred.

- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent, ambiguous, early-stage initiatives at once, and to make sound prioritization calls without waiting for full cross-functional consensus.

- Be comfortable quickly grasping and speaking credibly about new and emerging technologies (e.g. generative AI and cloud-based infrastructure) as they relate to creative tools, and translating their capabilities and known limitations into practical rollout plans.

- Working knowledge of media asset management concepts (e.g. asset types, metadata, interoperability, open standards across systems) and comfort partnering directly with technology teams on systems design.

- Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to socialize, explain, and gain buy-in for new and complex strategies, practices, and workflows. This includes being able to influence the direction of work without direct authority or reporting lines.

- Experience and capability to respectfully and confidently engage with executives, creative partners, and operational colleagues alike.

- Ability to manage and operate in ambiguous situations, and to think on your feet to solve problems in real time.

This role sits on Global Program Management's program management growth track. Strong performers are expected to grow into greater scope over time.

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $160,000.00 - $252,000.00.
Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here .

jobs.title: Pricing Strategy Manager
jobs.description:

We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Pricing is one of the most important business levers - every dollar of revenue and profit generated can be tied back, directly or indirectly, to a pricing decision. It sits at the intersection of product offering and consumer value. As the Pricing Strategy Manager, you are part of the Commerce Product Org and will be responsible for shaping and executing long-term strategy at the global and local level.

This role is based in our Los Gatos office (preferred) in a hybrid model. We are open to remote candidates who are on the West Coast. Some travel to Los Gatos will be required if remote-based.

Responsibilities:
- Develop pricing principles and global frameworks that integrate consumer demand, price elasticity, competitive landscape, and other factors

- Collaborate with a nimble team of stunning colleagues across Finance, Strategy Planning & Analysis, Data Science, and Consumer Insights to design and execute a learning agenda around consumer willingness to pay, price elasticity, price timing, and more

- Author memos and presentations that distill complex pricing trade-offs into clear strategic recommendations for senior executives and regional leadership, leveraging pricing principles and frameworks.

- Establish pricing recommendations for new products or services based on projected demand and profitability

- Drive pricing planning, with a cross-functional team that includes product, finance, regional analytics, data science, and local teams

- Build strong relationships across both local and global teams, ensuring alignment and support for price change decisions

- Maintain a comprehensive understanding of company-wide initiatives that would affect pricing decisions

Wishlist:
- 6+ years of experience in strategy, product, and/or consulting with a core focus on monetization and pricing. We are prioritizing candidates who have in-house corporate strategy/product experience, or have a mix of in-house strategy and consulting/banking/other professional services.

- In-depth pricing experience with a proven record of architecting and driving large-scale pricing programs and initiatives

- Worked in a direct-to-consumer business , preferably with global scope, where the consumer is paying for the service.

- Strong understanding of market dynamics and consumer behavior, across econ/finance and marketing disciplines.

- Passion for Growth, Pricing, and/or Behavioral Economics!

- Experience implementing AI tooling solutions to scale pricing programs/processes is a plus

Must Haves:
- Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; ability to distill complex concepts, trade-offs, and decisions at varying degrees of detail depending on the forum and seniority level of stakeholders

- Possess the quantitative fluency to independently pressure-test hypotheses and the strategic intuition to leverage data for high-stakes decision-making (e.g., comfort with self-serving data; proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets/; experience with SQL)

- Team player with strong interpersonal skills and an ability to influence and drive cross-functional outcomes

- Ability to work independently ; must thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment; able to manage multiple concurrent projects and stakeholders simultaneously

- Highly intellectually curious and has the courage to challenge the status quo

jobs.title: Manager, Finance and Strategy (F&S), Japan Partnerships
jobs.description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

The Finance and Strategy (F&S) team for Partnerships is seeking an experienced individual contributor to join our team, acting as a trusted thought partner to influence our partnerships strategy in the region. We have an opening for a Manager in our Japan team, based out of Tokyo. This role is primarily focused on defining partnership strategy and analyzing partnership opportunities, as well as supporting strategic growth initiatives to shape broader country strategy in Japan.

Partnerships are a critical driver of growth for Netflix. The most common types of partnerships are bundles. Our team evaluates opportunities with all partners (e.g. telcos, e-commerce) and analyzes their performance over time. During negotiations, we provide strategic guidance to the Business Development team using data and insights. When partnerships are launched, we monitor their performance and search for best practices and areas of improvement.

The team also plays a critical role in contributing to the broader growth strategy at the market level, providing competitive intelligence, local guidance on price and plan strategy, and driving learning agenda in conjunction with our Data Science and Engineering (DSE) and Consumer Insights (CI) teams.

This person will have a high degree of visibility with Netflix's senior leadership, who depend heavily on our strategic insights to inform critical business decisions and drive overall growth in Japan.

This role will be based in Tokyo and dual reports into the Head of F&S APAC Partnerships in Singapore and Head of F&S Japan in Tokyo.

Responsibilities:
- Co-pilot to senior stakeholders in Business Development team in defining partnerships strategy and deal commercials for negotiations

- Evaluate the financial impact of partnership opportunities (e.g. bundles) via financial projections and commercial scenario modeling

- Analyze the performance of existing partnerships to extract actionable insights (e.g. best practices, areas of improvement)

- Create insightful strategic presentations that facilitate decision-making for internal stakeholders and external partners

- Work cross-functionally with other teams working on Partnership or country growth initiatives (e.g. Partner Engagement, Marketing, Product, Consumer Insights)

- Partnering with Country F&S and Global Product teams to help identify, prioritize and assess the impact of new growth initiatives for Japan (e.g. new plans and offers)

- Develop a deep understanding of industry trends as well as competitive threats in Japan to better inform our future strategic choices

Qualifications:
- 10+ years of experience in a top management consulting firm and/or tech companies

- At least 3 years of management consulting experience or equivalent strategic and analytical roles in a high growth environment are strongly preferred

- A highly analytical and effective communicator, with significant experience in managing and influencing senior stakeholders

- A proven track record of performing quantitative and qualitative financial analysis, and driving strategic thinking independently and proactively

- Must thrive in a fast-paced environment, possess a high level of ownership and intellectual curiosity, focus selflessly on driving team results and exhibit the highest standards of integrity and ethics

- Skilled in preparing effective presentations with clear narratives and impactful visuals

- Adept at managing multiple projects and stakeholders on a regular basis

- Strong quantitative skills, proficiency in Excel; proficiency with SQL and Tableau a plus

- Bachelor’s or master’s degree with emphasis on quantitative coursework; MBA a plus

- English and Japanese language fluency is mandatory

jobs.description:

| The Team
The Finance team partners closely with leaders across Content, Ads, Marketing, Product, Partnerships, and Operations, connecting financial insight with strategic thinking to help the business make better decisions. We bring together perspectives from various teams to create one integrated view of the business.

| The Opportunity
We are looking for a Korea Finance Director, Strategy, Planning, and Studio Finance to lead one of Netflix's most dynamic and strategically important markets.

This role acts as a co-pilot of the Korea business and reports directly to the APAC CFO. It serves as the primary Finance & Strategy partner to the Korea Leadership Team (KLT), acting as a trusted business advisor and thought partner across the market.

Success in this role goes well beyond financial planning or reporting. You'll help shape country strategy, influence investment decisions, challenge assumptions, identify opportunities and risks, and connect cross-functional perspectives to drive stronger business outcomes. The ideal candidate would have an exceptionally strong business acumen, exceptional people and leadership skills, and a strong ability to influence without authority.

You will work across nearly every part of the business while collaborating closely with regional and global partners, making this an exceptional opportunity for someone who enjoys operating at the intersection of finance, strategy, and business leadership.

| Core Responsibilities:
- Serve as the Finance & Strategy leader for Korea and the primary strategic finance partner to the Korea Leadership Team.

- Act as the business co-pilot, translating financial insight into strategic recommendations that influence business decisions.

- Bring together multiple Finance teams, including FP&A, Content F&S, Content Accounting, and Production Finance, etc., to provide a holistic view of the business.

- Partner closely with cross-functional leaders across Content, Ads, Partnerships, Marketing, Product, and Operations to shape country priorities.

- Help define and execute the country strategy while aligning with broader regional and global objectives.

- Evaluate investment opportunities, business trade-offs, and resource allocation to maximize long-term business performance.

- Monitor financial, operational, and market risks while identifying opportunities for sustainable growth.

- Leverage market intelligence, competitive insights, and regional trends to support strategic decision-making.

- Foster alignment across local, regional, and global stakeholders, ensuring decisions are informed by both local context and broader company priorities.

| We're looking for:
We are interested in leaders who bring strong business judgment, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to connect finance with broader business strategy.
- 15+ years of experience in Finance, Strategy, or related business leadership roles within technology, media, entertainment, or other complex global organizations.

- A track record of partnering directly with senior business leaders to influence strategic decisions.

- Strong commercial acumen and the ability to understand how businesses grow, invest, and create long-term value.

- The ability to navigate ambiguity, simplify complex business problems, and make thoughtful recommendations.

- Effective executive communication skills, with experience influencing cross-functional stakeholders without relying on formal authority.

- A collaborative leadership style, bringing together diverse perspectives across local, regional, and global teams.

- Strong learning agility and curiosity, with the ability to quickly develop expertise across new business areas.

- A bias toward action, balanced with sound judgment and thoughtful decision-making.

- A demonstrated commitment to inclusion, collaboration, and building high-performing teams.

- Professional fluency in both Korean and English is essential, with the confidence to communicate clearly and build trusted partnerships across local, regional, and global stakeholders.

jobs.description:

Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

In November 2022, Netflix launched an ad-supported tier, enabling the delivery of standard :15 and :30 ads. Since then, we've expanded our suite of advertising solutions and have grown our ad-supported monthly active user count to more than 80 million globally.

We are now scaling capabilities that focus on live content, brand integrations, and other opportunities that allow brands to partner with us across an even wider Netflix footprint. Netflix is rapidly expanding its advertising business across Europe, bringing our ad-supported tier to new markets and growing our sales operations footprint across the region.

As our Ads program scales, we’re building out a team that will help steward and support our go-to-market strategy, specialising in Sales Operations. Visit our culture memo and long-term view to learn more about the unique Netflix culture and the opportunity to be part of our team.

The position reports to the Senior Manager, Sales Operations and is based in London.

What You'll do
- Partner with the UK Country Leader on GTM sales strategy: client segmentation, solutions, and service levels for the UK market, including defining resourcing, sales org structure, and sales territories
- Lead sales operations processes across revenue forecasting, pipeline management, quota planning, and monthly business reviews
- Analyse sales performance and surface insights from large datasets spanning revenue, pipeline, product, and sales process
- Collaborate with cross-functional partners in Market Activation, Finance & Strategy, HR, and Business Operations to deliver Ads-wide projects, and represent Sales requirements and considerations
- Manage sales data (accounts, account teams, territories, reports, opportunities, activities) in the CRM system
- Work closely with sales, account management, solutions, measurement, and other cross-functional teams to provide quantitative and qualitative analysis of programme performance, ensuring measurable business impact
- Build weekly, monthly, and quarterly review materials for senior leadership to inform business decisions
- Lead discussions on business performance and take accountability for outcomes

We value skills and impact over credentials. We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every criterion — what matters most is what you bring, not how you got there.
- Substantial experience in digital advertising, with a background in Sales Operations covering large enterprise client teams (typically gained over 7 or more years, though additional experience through non-traditional paths is also valued)
- Experience building and managing relationships with senior sales stakeholders at the country, regional, or agency level
- Familiarity with the digital advertising landscape and agency or client-direct advertising sales models is required, ideally with a focus on the UK
- Strong spreadsheet skills
- Demonstrated ability to independently direct work and influence decision-making, including in cross-functional settings where you don't have direct authority
- Ability to collaborate effectively and actively incorporate diverse perspectives and experiences when making decisions
- Proven ability to prioritise and manage multiple projects efficiently

Preferred Qualifications
- SQL and data analytics experience
- Experience with automation and scalable tooling

Role & Responsibilities

Partner Operations is obsessed with making direct delivery simpler for new content partners and the Netflix teams who receive and launch their titles day-to-day. We evaluate what the partner can deliver, how those assets might move through fulfillment and launch systems, and what it takes to support the deal day to day.

As a Partner Operations Manager, you will be the operational lead across an assigned slate of deals. You will assess what a partner can deliver, decide the appropriate delivery path, guide the partner through first deliveries and set up a process that Operations teams can run day to day. You will balance the partner experience with the work required of Netflix teams and vendors, and make the important decisions and handoffs clear.

In this role, you will:
- Clarify deal goals, asset and localization needs, timing, partner contacts and open questions with Business Development, Regional Merchandising and Content teams as deals move into delivery planning.
- Assess the partner’s ability to meet our specs. Compare their needs with Netflix’s current system and operational capabilities; identify what is missing, what may need to be built and the effort required from integration through stable operations.
- Apply gateway eligibility criteria agreed with Engineering to determine delivery through UI, API or a vendor route. Work with Ops Vendor Management on the vendor model and cost, considering the effort for the partner and Netflix teams.
- Lead pre-qualification across long-form and promotional assets. Coordinate sample and quality reviews, then determine which assets Netflix can accept or conform, what the partner must change and whether vendor or post-vendor QC is needed.
- Turn partner context and deal nuance into clear technical and operational requirements for Product and Engineering. Frame the problem, define the workflow and write user stories where useful, making timing, constraints and trade-offs clear. Work with PACT and Solution Engineering on configuration and integration questions.
- Prepare partners to meet spec, coordinate tests and work through first deliveries. Answer delivery and spec questions clearly, bring in technical specialists when needed and remove early blockers.
- Keep partners, vendors and internal teams aligned on decisions, risks, owners and next steps. Communicate early and on time, and anticipate what each team will need before it becomes a problem.
- Hand off the partner profile, setup and open risks to the Launch Ops project manager once delivery is reliable.

Requirements:
- Substantial experience independently leading complex partner onboarding, post-production, content operations, or product launches. This is a role for someone who has taken ambiguous, multi-team work from planning through launch and stable operations.
- Proven project or technical program management experience, with strong judgment on priorities, dependencies, risk and when to escalate.
- Excellent partner management. You build trust, set expectations, navigate difficult conversations and stay several steps ahead of partners and internal teams.
- Clear, timely written and verbal communication. You can explain technical and operational issues in plain language and turn them into decisions, owners and next steps.
- Strong experience coordinating Product, Engineering, Operations, business teams and external vendors toward a common launch outcome.
- Confidence working directly with Product and Engineering. You can turn partner context into clear problem statements, workflow requirements and user stories; discuss APIs and configurations; and understand engineering roadmap priorities and trade-offs.
- An understanding of the Netflix product or comparable streaming products, the content delivery and fulfillment ecosystem, and how delivery choices affect the member experience. Familiarity with media specifications, media processing, QC and direct delivery tools is helpful.
- The ability to move comfortably between detail and the end-to-end picture, making the partner experience simpler while keeping ongoing operational work sustainable.

jobs.title: General Program Manager (L5) - Developer Enablement
jobs.description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

The Developer Education (DevEd) team empowers every Netflix employee to create, innovate, and deliver at their best by providing accessible, relevant, and high-quality learning experiences. Our product is a more knowledgeable and capable Netflix workforce, not any single educational program. Our outcome is collective innovation, efficiency, and increased productivity across our enterprise..

DevEd operates as the Hub of educational expertise at Netflix, partnering with domain teams who provide deep local context and domain-specific content. We are catalysts and enablers, not gatekeepers. We focus on four strategic pillars: Onboarding & Foundational Learning, Continuing Education & Enablement, Documentation Excellence, and Innovation Enablement.

About the role

General Program Manager L5 with breadth and depth of experience in Developer Education and Enablement.

We are seeking an innovative, proactive learning enabler who is passionate about technical training and documentation, and who will amplify how engineers across Netflix learn, ship, and leverage AI in their day-to-day work.

In this role, you will own global developer learning programs end to end: from onboarding and ongoing education to documentation strategy, AI-assisted workflows, and analytics on developer productivity. You will design and deliver high-impact training, drive key enablement initiatives, and work across Engineering, Product, and Support to create learning experiences that measurably reduce friction and boost developer velocity.

This role is pivotal in accelerating developer velocity through jobs-to-be-done (JTBD) driven learning experiences. As a highly trusted individual contributor, you will shape how our global engineering organization learns, adopts new tools, and continuously improves how we build.

Role will require occasional travel to Netflix offices for onboarding, learning events, and quarterly onsites.

What you will do...
- Design and deliver customized onboarding programs and continuing education experiences through engaging formats tailored for various engineering personas.

- Manage and prioritize requests for new and updated technical training and documentation, ensuring alignment with strategic goals and learning needs.

- Guide content creation alongside stakeholders using a train-the-trainer model, enabling domain teams to scale their own educational efforts.

- Create insightful dashboards and performance metrics from raw data to measure and iterate on the effectiveness of onboarding programs, training sessions, and documentation quality.

- Partner with internal and external program managers, instructional designers, technical writers, SMEs, and facilitators for program execution.

- Foster a culture of continuous learning that promotes inclusion and empowers employees to own their growth.

Your experience must include or demonstrate…
- Confidence in public speaking, with experience delivering technical content to diverse audiences, including seasoned engineers and people leaders.

- Hands-on experience with GenAI tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude, Copilot) and ability to model effective AI-assisted workflows for technical audiences.

- Ability to derive and apply data insights (support ticket analysis, learning outcomes, dashboards) to guide decisions

- Track record of enabling and empowering teams/SMEs to create their own training content (e.g. train-the-trainer, hub-spoke models).

- Proficiency in creating and editing engaging documentation, with strong opinions on documentation strategy, sustainability, and information architecture.

- Ability to manage and prioritize a large volume and variety of requests while maintaining focus on high-impact, strategic initiatives.

- Experience designing blended learning formats (live, hybrid, async, self-paced)

- Experience leading large-scale initiatives end to end, and influencing stakeholders up, down, and across the organization

Other attributes that will excite us…
- Deep GenAI fluency and enthusiasm for AI-powered productivity tools

- Strong technical understanding and comfort collaborating closely with engineers

- Experience optimizing global or remote training across multiple time zones

- Familiarity with LMS or similar learning platforms

- Experience balancing central standards with local team autonomy in training and documentation

- Track record of running technical education or community events (internal conferences, tech talks, hackathons)

- Clear perspective on inclusive learning design for a diverse, global workforce

- Experience driving cultural or process change in engineering organizations

- Ability to benchmark tools (AI and otherwise) against internal developer use cases and make evidence-based recommendations
